Product Features

  • Multifunctional Design: This bed has several functions, including a rechargeable USB port on the bed, LED lighting, and a three-level angle adjustment function on the bed. This makes the bed more practical and meets the diverse needs of users, such as charging, reading or watching movies.
  • Intelligent Control: The LED bedside lamp is equipped with a remote control, which makes it easy to adjust the brightness and flashing frequency of the lamp. With this smart control, users can adjust the lighting to suit their preferences and needs, creating a comfortable sleeping environment or just the right light for reading.
  • Waterproof Material: The bed surface is made of waterproof PU material, which makes the bed have a longer lifespan and is easy to clean and maintain. This feature is especially suitable for accidental water spills or water spills that can occur in daily life.
  • Modern Appearance: This bed has a gray design, simple and elegant, suitable for the modern interior style. The design of the bed with Type-C and LED interfaces is not only powerful, but also gives a sense of modernity and technology, making the whole bed more attractive.
  • Both comfort and practicality: the recommended thickness of the mattress is less than 28 cm (do not exceed, otherwise it will block the bed and not be able to adjust the angle), the wattage of the LED lamp is 4 W, the load capacity is 300 kg, and the adjustment angle on the bed is 0–30°.
